rows.rule_yaml:
title: User-Space Executable Spawning Cmd.exe to Run Executable with Private IP Argument
id: 8a3ac2fb-54b7-50b4-930b-9518f446366d
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-system executable in a user-writable directory spawning
  cmd.exe to execute another executable from a user-writable directory with a private
  IP address argument, indicating adversary use of Windows command shell for execution
  of a malicious file with C2 communication.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-06'
tags:
- attack.t1059.003
- attack.t1204.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    ParentImage|contains:
    - \Users\\
    - \AppData\\
    - \Temp\\
    - \Desktop\\
    - \Downloads\\
    - \Public\\
    Image|endswith:
    - cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - .exe
    - '172.'
  selection2:
    ParentImage|contains:
    - \Users\\
    - \AppData\\
    - \Temp\\
    - \Desktop\\
    - \Downloads\\
    - \Public\\
    Image|endswith:
    - cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - .exe
    - 192.168.
  selection3:
    ParentImage|contains:
    - \Users\\
    - \AppData\\
    - \Temp\\
    - \Desktop\\
    - \Downloads\\
    - \Public\\
    Image|endswith:
    - cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - .exe
    - '10.'
  condition: 1 of selection*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative scripts running from user profile that invoke cmd.exe
  to execute tools with IP arguments (rare)
level: high
